assumptions.text: No task assignee/candidate group documented; the four user tasks are left unassigned (same gap as SR-3).

Branch precedence and default are undocumented (D03 ¶93–115): nothing says which flag wins if several are true, or what happens if none is. Conditions are emitted in document order with no default flow.

Flag reset on loop-back is undocumented (D03 ¶102–103, ¶112–113): nothing clears isAddEmployee / isAddSubcontractor when a search screen returns, so the same branch is taken again unless the form resets the flag.

assumptions.text: The two write nodes carry no task type in the diagram (D03 ¶124, ¶129); modelled as service tasks. MapEmployeeStore and MapSubcontractorStore are proposed test doubles; real write semantics unspecified (same gap as SR-4).
CONFLICT: D03 ¶220 counts 3 forms (allocation + 2 search); the flow diagram has a fourth user task, Allocation Confirmation (D03 ¶118–119). Model follows the diagram.
CONFLICT: D04 ¶97 gives Allocation Confirmation a Back button returning to the allocation screen; the flow diagram shows no path back from it (D03 ¶118–124). Model follows the diagram: no back flow.
Process name template is dynamic (D03 ¶49); the BPMN process name is the static model name.
The documented projectInfo default (D03 ¶61) is not carried into the spec.

Target-design proposals pending approval: class names (ProjectRegistration reused for NSSOL Projects; Employee, Subcontractor, MapEmployee, MapSubcontractor), DateTime as java.time.LocalDateTime, list variables as java.util.List, and every user-task output.
Cancelling a search screen is documented as returning without selection (D04 ¶251); the merged return flow carries no condition, so nothing in the process enforces it.
